title: a16z Podcast: The Why, How, and When of Sales

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: The hallmark of many great technical founder/CEOs is that they envision a better way of doing things.
reader_summary.overview: The hallmark of many great technical founder/CEOs is that they envision a better way of doing things. But this very mindset can backfire when it comes to sales. Why shouldn't they reinvent the sales process?? Finally, how do we wrap our heads around sales culture, competition, and commissions in startups?

key_points.text: The hallmark of many great technical founder/CEOs is that they envision a better way of doing things.
It doesn't help when everyone in the company -- not just sales reps -- are the ones building the very thing you're selling ...
so why the special rewards for sales?
